lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all change types with only one test completed so far.

candidates.title: Postpone Account Sign In
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users build an emotional bond before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early and has a long mean duration of 567s before users even choose a pet.

guard.reason: Moving sign in after adoption pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Postponing sign-in reduces early friction where 27.1% of users drop off.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout featuring live pet preview and official certificate styling.
candidates.why: Adoption drops nearly 40% of users (60.9% conversion) and has a long median time of 89s.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated interactive screen explaining desktop pet controls and key shortcuts right before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after setup.

new_controls_guide.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_guide.body: Learn quick shortcuts to interact, chat, or minimize your pet while working.

components.text: Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls guide screen inside onboarding before home intro is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses multiple support emails, but requires building a new screen.

candidates.title: Pet Account Recovery Flow
candidates.change: Add a dedicated account verification and pet restore action directly on the sign-in screen for returning users.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets going missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in_options.text: Existing user? Sign in to restore your saved pets.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[1]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Troubleshooting Status
candidates.change: Display progress indicators, time estimates, and desktop visibility troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop, while waiting step median time is 201s.

waiting.hint: If your pet does not appear on your desktop, check your taskbar tray or press Alt+P.

components.text: Ensure desktop overlay permissions are allowed in system settings.

guard.reason: Adding troubleshooting status and hints to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Solves reported pet spawn issues and long median wait time on home step.

candidates.title: Account Pet Cloud Backup Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit hint copy on sign-in clarifying that logging in links all adopted pets permanently to the user account.
candidates.why: Users lost or reset their pets when signing in with alternate account credentials.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main email to keep your pet customization and adoption records safely backed up.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Photo Upload Pet Generation Guidance
candidates.change: Provide clear photo quality guidelines and file format hints on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failures or poor visually generated results.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit single-subject photos for the best 3D pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adding photo quality guidance and file format tips to the photo upload screen is valid within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost guidance update targeting the largest step drop (39.1%) backed by support tickets.

candidates.title: Path Selection Step Counter & Clear Options
candidates.change: Update headline and body while enabling the step counter on the choose path screen to set clear expectations.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a very high mean time of 514s despite a median of 8s, indicating hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select whether you want to adopt a ready companion or craft a custom pet.

guard.reason: Updating copy and enabling a step counter while preserving both adoption and custom pet paths is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy and counter change to address hesitation on initial path selection.

candidates.title: Two-Column Home Intro Dashboard
candidates.change: Reorganize the home intro screen into a two-column dashboard layout presenting quick setup steps clearly.
candidates.why: Finish step drops 35.2% of users (64.8% completion) with a median duration of 395s.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home to Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout within onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Redesign of finish layout to help reduce 35.2% drop-off rate.

candidates.title: Background Notification When Pet is Ready
candidates.change: Enable background notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when their pet finishes loading.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has an average wait time of 2336s, suggesting users switch away to other desktop apps.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet...
waiting.body: Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding notification options to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Re-engages users during long 2336s mean waiting time via background alerts.

held_by_harm_budget: Path Selection Step Counter & Clear Options
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for both adoption redesigns and sign-in reordering, as only one test has been completed for each kind of change.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to the noise-corrected measurements in both rounds.
